extensionFix.finding: An edit or newer request during an asynchronous save could let an obsolete request start verification
extensionFix.resolution: Track pending-save request identities, invalidate them on edits/closure/cancellation/new requests, bound save retries, and require a clean buffer
extensionFix.preservedInvariant: Exact backend/editor source-hash equality remains mandatory
extensionFix.remainingBoundary: VS Code 1.108 can report a newer buffer clean after writing older bytes. The live scenario records both hashes and uses explicit editor Save for recovery; automatic persistence recovery remains partial.

concurrencyAddendum.finding: Each ExecutionEngine creates its own checker pool and VcsCores semaphore. Dafny ProjectManager.GetBoogie owns an engine per project, so whole-server multi-project activity is not a global worker-count cap.
concurrencyAddendum.runtimeScope: CPU-active process counts cover the entire suite, including concurrent projects, cancellation and restart; they do not establish exact simultaneous instructions.
